experience: Highest and lowest comparable occurrence utilization

definitions.waitlist: Distinct supported entries and promotions, not inferred complete legacy demand
definitions.attended: Present on reserved bookings for ended non-cancelled classes
definitions.utilization: Recorded attended divided by capacity of ended non-cancelled classes; capacity-weighted aggregation
definitions.booked: Current reserved bookings, separate from waitlist and cancellations
definitions.noShows: Explicit absent attendance on reserved bookings for ended non-cancelled classes
definitions.capacity: Current non-cancelled class capacity; not remaining unbooked seats
definitions.cancellations: Current early, late and unclassified booking cancellations; cancelled occurrences counted separately

access.frontDesk: Existing daily desk access, no management report
access.permission: Existing reports.read, exact business and account scope
access.instructor: Existing assigned-class attendance/history, no management report

dates: Vega Pacific dates; configurable timezone in reusable projector; inclusive ranges; Monday weeks; current corrected records; empty periods omitted
quality: Zero, unavailable and not applicable distinguished; unrecorded attendance not treated as absence; invalid capacity and conflicting records flagged; incomplete rates labelled
reuse: Pure read-only projection; no database writes, new permission system, migrations or transaction logic

hostedBrowser.presentation: Browser refreshed after deployment to load current client
checks: Weekly trend separates future not-applicable rate
